Branding for Primecrest
Logos and branding, Brand guidelines
Brief
Design a brand identity for Prime Crest Farms, an emerging agricultural brand with a strong focus on livestock and livestock-related services. The brand stands at the intersection of tradition and innovation—delivering modern, sustainable, and quality-driven agricultural services.
